messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: synthetic-canary-eu-west-1 TLS handshake failure spike. threshold=3/min, current=18/min. probeId=canary-eu-west-1-01. link=https://pagerduty.example/INC123456 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: New incident INC123456 created by synthetic-monitoring. Urgency: high. Acknowledgement required.
maya (oncall): ACKing and grabbing triage. Looking at canary dashboard now.
maya (oncall): quick look — failures are TLS handshake errors from our canary runner, not backend 5xx. No increase in customer 5xx at edge (checking prod-edge).
samir: do we have any deploys or infra changes in last 10m?
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "lb-cert-rotate eu-west-1 started by infra-auto-rotate at 2026-03-14T08:22:13Z"
jordan: that timing aligns. Canaries run from internal probes using strict TLS settings — maybe cert chain changed.
maya (oncall): running curl from a canary runner VM:```
$ curl -v https://inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example/health
* Rebuilt URL to: https://inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example/health
*   Trying 10.0.5.23...
* Connected to inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example (10.0.5.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
```
maya (oncall): handshake failure error during TLS record read.
alejandra: any client certs involved? Canaries use default system trust store. Infra rotated LB certs — maybe missing intermediate?
maya (oncall): checking cert chain with openssl s_client:```
$ openssl s_client -connect inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example:443 -servername inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example
   i:/CN=redwood-infra-rotated-intermediate
 1 s:/CN=redwood-infra-rotated-intermediate
   i:/CN=GlobalRoot
---
---
no peer certificate available
---
```
samir: looks like the rotated cert chain is missing the root or the intermediate on the LB side. That could cause older TLS stacks in the probe to fail. Some probes use older openssl.
jordan: can we confirm this from load balancer config?
ops-bot: infra-lb-agent: current cert bundle for lb-eu-west-1 = cert_v20260314(rotated), intermediates included: [rotated-intermediate]. previous bundle = cert_v20260201 (works).
maya (oncall): quick mitigation options: 1) rollback LB cert to previous bundle 2) temporarily relax probe TLS verification (probing only) 3) patch canary runner to use newer trust store. Preference: rollback cert to stop pager noise and unambiguously fix probe compatibility.
alejandra: customer impact? if only probes failing and no user-facing 5xx, maybe no impact, but we need to confirm telemetry.
maya (oncall): checking ingress logs and SLO dashboards — p50/p95 unchanged, 5xx rate at edge unchanged. Only synth fail rate up. So customer-facing impact = none detected.
samir: I'll coordinate a rollback of LB cert to cert_v20260201. Doing rollback now, ETA ~7m. Jordan — can you hold on muting PD until we see result? We want to ensure we don't miss a real regression.
jordan: yep.
maya (oncall): running a targeted test after rollback completes.
ops-bot: infra-lb-agent: rollback started for lb-eu-west-1 by samir at 2026-03-14T08:29:02Z
pagerduty: INC123456 acknowledged by maya (oncall) — responder: maya (oncall).
samir: rollback complete. applied cert_v20260201 at 2026-03-14T08:31:10Z.
maya (oncall): re-running curl test:```
$ curl -v https://inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example/health
* Connected to inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example (10.0.5.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.2 connection using ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
* Server certificate: CN=inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example
* Server certificate: CN=Redwood-Intermediate
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: inference-eu-west-1.redwood.example
> User-Agent: curl/7.58.0
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"ok":true}
```
maya (oncall): canary runner now succeeding. I'm seeing realtime synth failures drop to zero.
jordan: nice. Can we re-enable the stricter probe or keep this? We should fix rotated bundle generation process to include full chain.
samir: agreed. I'll open infra ticket to update auto-rotate to bundle full chain and add canary smoke tests to cert rollout. ticket: INFRA-7892.
alejandra: paging noise impact to on-call: high churn for 15m. Any customer-facing incidents? none. We should update status page? probably not.
maya (oncall): assessment: scope limited to synthetic probes in eu-west-1, root cause: incomplete certificate chain in rotated bundle. Impact: no customer 5xx, no SLO violations detected; customer-facing latency unchanged. Duration: ~9 minutes of probe failures (08:22:13Z–08:31:10Z).
jordan: recommend: 1) infra ticket INFRA-7892 to fix rotation pipeline 2) add canary cert-check preflight 3) rollback confirmed, close PD incident after 10m of stable checks.
maya (oncall): I'll monitor for 10m, then close. Leaving PD ack.
incident-bot: INC123456 marked as in_progress by maya (oncall).
(9 minutes later)
maya (oncall): 10m stable after rollback, canaries green across eu-west/eu-central. Closing PD incident.
pagerduty: INC123456 resolved by maya (oncall) — root cause: cert chain incomplete after automated rotation.
ops-bot: :thumbsup: reaction from samir
maya (oncall): filing summary for postmortem and linking INFRA-7892. Thanks all for quick coord. :heart:
